title: Filtered GitHub Actions workflow-run provider contract

observed: GitHub's repository workflow-runs endpoint accepts head_sha and returns only runs associated with that commit.
The endpoint permits at most 100 records per page.
When actor, branch, check_suite_id, created, event, head_sha, or status filters are used, GitHub documents a maximum of 1000 results per search.
Private-repository use requires authenticated read access to Actions.
inferred: Following every pagination link is necessary but insufficient to prove provider-complete coverage for filtered searches.
A ten-page result at per_page=100 is ambiguous unless an independently bounded query proves that the true result set is below the provider ceiling.
proposed: Treat any filtered traversal returning 1000 records as provider_ceiling_ambiguous and fail closed.
Retain request parameters, API-version header, page count, per-page value, total_count, returned count, retrieval timestamps, and raw page digests.
Require independent reconciliation before promoting exact-commit workflow evidence.
unresolved: GitHub does not document a response field that proves a filtered result set exceeded the 1000-result ceiling.
The operational API version used by the authenticated client must be recorded because documentation examples may change over time.

sources.title: REST API endpoints for workflow runs

falsification_route: Run an authenticated fixture repository with more than 1000 matching workflow runs for one supported filter and record actual pagination behavior.
Compare REST traversal, gh api --paginate --slurp output, reported total_count, and independently known fixture cardinality.
Revise this contract if GitHub introduces a documented exhaustive endpoint, cursor, or explicit truncation indicator.
privacy_boundary: Contains only public provider documentation and abstract evidence-contract fields; no credentials, repository secrets, private workflow data, or user content.
